auditor.method: commit-range security and correctness review with executable regression and ownership gates

findings.evidence: The committed end-to-end PDF dispatch regression creates a temporary workspace without a Git repository. During session/prompt the checkpoint availability guard returns CheckpointUnavailable before the PDF wire gate; the asserted nanoError.kind is therefore null instead of model_lacks_pdf. The affected-crate audit command reproduces the failure at the audited commit, so the mandatory test gate is not green and the zero-call/no-persistence runtime proof is not currently executable as written.

On Windows, reject_link_components iterates the canonical verbatim path and calls symlink_metadata after pushing Prefix before RootDir. Inspecting the verbatim Prefix alone fails, so the complete live ACP PDF path returns nanoError.kind fs_read_denied with message 'document_path: cannot inspect path' from crates/nano-protocol/src/acp.rs:296 before the model call.

Strict clippy reports items_after_test_module at line 370 and field_reassign_with_default at line 376. Both errors were introduced by commit b3f49343 and prevent the mandatory nano-model lint gate from passing.

Strict clippy reports items_after_test_module at line 306 and field_reassign_with_default at lines 315 and 329. All three errors were introduced by commit b3f49343 and prevent the mandatory nano-model lint gate from passing.

GOALS, the WP-0.3 specification, and the owner contract require the Flux Router Anthropic endpoint /v1/messages. The compatibility /anthropic/v1/messages route returned HTTP 200 but produced zero document-token delta and a false external oracle; the temporary path-only diagnostic changed only the endpoint to /v1/messages and produced delta 13831 with the oracle true.

The live harness first deadlocked on an unanswered session/request_permission request, then after that stage was bypassed wrote repository evidence under the monorepo root instead of the active worktree and failed its post-write reopen with NotFound. The final harness needs test-only tool clearing and a token cap, a deny responder for unexpected permission requests, and repository-root verification derived from the compiled crate rather than the monorepo workspace locator.

The gate-all nano-session library test p2a_op_never_denies_unknown_fields fails because the DocumentRef helper introduced a literal serde deny_unknown_fields attribute while the Op forward-field contract scans the source. The focused command completed 118 tests successfully and failed this one test at crates/nano-session/src/op.rs:824.
Value-based DocumentRef deserialization collapsed duplicate known JSON members before validation; focused review required rejection of repeated known members while preserving journal field tolerance.
